scenes.title: The Touchless Vision
scenes.text: What if your Mac could understand your hands? Not by reaching out to touch the glass, but through the natural air in front of you. This is touchless computing.

scenes.title: Product Hero Reveal
scenes.text: Meet Swipy. A native macOS app that transforms your built-in FaceTime camera into an intelligent spatial trackpad. No sensors to wear, no extra hardware. Just pure, fluid control.

scenes.title: Vision & Cursor Precision
scenes.text: Glide your index finger to steer the cursor with sub-millimeter precision. Touch your thumb and index together to grab, lock on, and drag windows effortlessly across your workspace.

scenes.title: 18 Native Gestures
scenes.text: Swipe four fingers through the air to switch Spaces. Tap, scroll with open palm, or clench your fist to freeze tracking. Eighteen native gestures designed for your everyday workflow.

scenes.title: 100% On-Device Privacy
scenes.text: Best of all, your privacy is absolute. Everything runs entirely on-device with Apple Vision and the Neural Engine. Zero video ever leaves your Mac, and zero network calls are made.

scenes.title: Commercial Finale & Invitation
scenes.text: Control your Mac with a wave of your hand. Completely free, open source, and built natively for Apple Silicon. Download Swipy today and experience touchless computing.
